title: Distribution benefits (CFCs) — s 47A ITAA 1936
summary: Facet map: is a CFC distribution benefit deemed a dividend under s 47A? Spine: unlisted-country CFC threshold (s 47A(1)(b)-(d), after 3 June 1990) → profits immediately before distribution (s 47A(1)(a), s 47A(15)) → eligible benefit categories — waiver (s 47A(5)-(6)), non-arm's length loan (s 47A(7)), share/unit/right/option acquisition (s 47A(8)), property/services transfer (s 47A(10), (10A) roll-over, (10)(c)-(f) carve-outs), payment on call (s 47A(11)) → s 47A(9)/(12) exclusions (no other eligible-interest holder in first company AND recipient) with s 47A(13)-(14) recapture (including (13)(ba)) → deemed dividend (s 47A(1)(d)-(g)) → s 44 assessability subject to s 23AI / s 768-5 NANE. s 47A(2) notification limitation affects s 365 and Div 770. FACETS: associate definition and benefit provider/arranger (s 47A(3)-(4)), recapture (s 47A(13)-(14)), assessment machinery (s 47A(18A), (19), (20)), profits computation (s 47A(15)-(17)), partnership/trust reduction (s 47A(18)), amendment (s 47A(18B)). Subsection coverage: s 47A(1)-(21) mapped (incl ss (18), (18B), (21) definitions).

nodes.label: A CFC provides a distribution benefit — is it deemed a dividend under s 47A?
nodes.body: Single question with facets. Spine: unlisted-country CFC threshold → profits → eligible benefit categories → exclusions → deemed dividend → assessability. Facets carry the machinery.

nodes.label: Is the first company a CFC resident in an unlisted country at the distribution time (s 47A(1)(b)-(d))?
nodes.body: The distribution time must be after 3 June 1990 (s 47A(1)(b)); the company must be a CFC (s 47A(1)(c)) resident in an unlisted country (s 47A(1)(d)). Listed-country CFCs are outside s 47A.

nodes.label: Not an unlisted-country CFC — s 47A does not apply
nodes.body: The benefit may still be a dividend under s 6(1) or caught by other provisions (s 44, Div 7A, transferor trust rules).

nodes.label: Does the company have profits immediately before the distribution time (s 47A(1)(a))?
nodes.body: s 47A(15): profits are determined assuming the company's accounts had been drawn up immediately before the distribution time. s 47A(16)-(17): amounts already included under s 44 reduce later profits to prevent double counting.

nodes.label: No profits — no deemed dividend
nodes.body: The benefit is not deemed a dividend under s 47A(1). Other rules may still apply.

nodes.label: Is the benefit a distribution benefit within s 47A(3)-(14)?
nodes.body: s 47A(3): a distribution benefit requires an eligible benefit where ALL of: (a) provided to an associated entity (or entity that becomes associated); (b) provided by the first company OR by an arranger under an arrangement with the first company; (c) if (b)(ii) applies — the first company made or undertook arrangement transfers attributable to the benefit. Eligible benefit categories: ss (5) waiver, (7) loan, (8) share/unit acquisition, (10) property/services transfer, (11) payment on call. Subject to ss (9)/(12) exclusions.

nodes.label: Is it a waiver/release of an obligation (s 47A(5))?
nodes.body: s 47A(5): waiving or releasing an obligation to pay or repay an amount is an eligible benefit. s 47A(6): an entity is taken to be under an obligation even if the amount is not due for payment or repayment.

nodes.label: Or a non-arm's length loan (s 47A(7))?
nodes.body: s 47A(7): a loan is an eligible benefit where (a) the parties are not at arm's length in relation to the loan, or (b) a purpose was to facilitate a dividend that would be non-assessable non-exempt income under s 768-5, or (c) a purpose was to facilitate the provision of an eligible benefit that is a distribution benefit in relation to any company.

nodes.label: Or a share/right/option acquisition (s 47A(8))?
nodes.body: s 47A(8): (a) acquiring a share, right or option from a COMPANY is an eligible benefit; (b) acquiring a unit, right or option from the TRUSTEE of a UNIT TRUST is also an eligible benefit. Subject to the s 47A(9) exclusion (no other eligible-interest holder).

nodes.label: Or a property/services transfer for inadequate consideration (s 47A(10))?
nodes.body: s 47A(10): transferring property/services for no or inadequate consideration is an eligible benefit to the extent of the shortfall — BUT ONLY IF: (c) services do not consist of making a loan (→ test under s 47A(7)); (d) property/services not consideration for share/right/option acquisition (→ test under s 47A(8)); (e) property/services not for unit/right/option acquisition (→ s 47A(8)(b)); (f) property not a payment on a call (→ test under s 47A(11)). s 47A(10A): certain CGT roll-over transfers (ss 70-30/70-110 ITAA 1997) are excluded.

nodes.label: Or a payment on a call on shares (s 47A(11))?
nodes.body: s 47A(11): a payment on a call on shares is an eligible benefit — subject to the s 47A(12) exclusion (mirror of s 47A(9)).

nodes.label: Not an eligible benefit — no deemed dividend
nodes.body: Outside ss 47A(5),(7),(8),(10),(11). Check the s 6(1) dividend definition and other integrity rules.

nodes.label: Do the s 47A(9)/(12) exclusions apply?
nodes.body: s 47A(9) (shares/units) and (12) (calls): NOT a distribution benefit if there is no entity (other than the provider) who is: (a) either the holder of an eligible equity interest in the FIRST COMPANY or an associate of such a holder; AND (b) the holder of an eligible equity interest in the RECIPIENT. s 47A(13)-(14): recapture where the exclusion later ceases to apply. NOTE: the exclusion only applies to s 47A(8) and (11) benefits.

nodes.label: Excluded — not a distribution benefit
nodes.body: No other eligible-interest holder (s 47A(9)/(12)). Watch recapture under s 47A(13)-(14).

nodes.label: So much of the payment as does not exceed profits is deemed a dividend (s 47A(1)(d)-(g))
nodes.body: Deemed dividend to the recipient as shareholder, out of profits, at the distribution time. Flows into s 44.

nodes.label: Assessable under s 44, or NANE under s 23AI / s 768-5?
nodes.body: By virtue of s 47A(1), the deemed dividend is included under s 44 (if assessable) or would be but for s 23AI (attributed income) or s 768-5 (participation exemption) — see s 47A(2)(a). If s 23AI or s 768-5 applies, the amount is non-assessable non-exempt income (NANE).

nodes.label: NANE under s 23AI / s 768-5 ITAA 1997
nodes.body: Not assessable to that extent — the underlying income was already attributed or the participation exemption applies.

nodes.label: Deemed dividend assessable under s 44
nodes.body: Included in assessable income under s 44. s 47A(18A) allows assessment on the assumption s 47A(2) will not be satisfied.

nodes.label: FACET — Distribution benefit definition and associates (s 47A(3)-(4))
nodes.body: Where to look: s 47A(3)(a) — benefit to an associated entity (or entity that becomes associated); s 47A(3)(b)(i) — benefit provided by the first company OR (ii) by an arranger under an arrangement; s 47A(3)(c) — where (b)(ii) applies, the first company must have made or undertaken arrangement transfers attributable to the benefit. s 47A(4) — undertaking to make arrangement transfers: distribution time is when the undertaking was entered into. The associate concept follows s 318 Part X.

nodes.label: FACET — Recapture (s 47A(13)-(14))
nodes.body: Where to look: s 47A(13) — benefit excluded under s 47A(9)/(12) becomes a distribution benefit at a later time when another entity holds an eligible equity interest in both the first company AND the recipient, AND if the benefit was a share/unit acquisition — the share/unit has NOT been redeemed or bought back for arm's length value (s 47A(13)(ba)). s 47A(14) — RECIPIENT provides a SECOND eligible benefit to the first company/provider/associate, and the first benefit facilitated the second benefit; with timing conditions for post-13 Sept 1990 benefits or Commissioner anti-avoidance opinion.

nodes.label: FACET — Assessment machinery (ss 47A(18)-(19))
nodes.body: Where to look: s 47A(18A) (assessment on the assumption s 47A(2) will not be satisfied — preserves the Commissioner's ability to assess underlying CFC income); s 47A(19) (s 102AAJ applies — related assessments); s 47A(20) (listed/unlisted question determined under Part X ss 320-321).

nodes.label: FACET — Profits computation (s 47A(15))
nodes.body: Where to look: s 47A(15) — profits determined by assuming the company's accounts were drawn up immediately before the distribution time (not a Part X assumption). s 47A(16)-(17) — rules reducing later profits by amounts already included under s 44, preventing double counting across distribution times. s 47A(18) — partnership/trust later-profit reduction. The deemed dividend is capped at profits (s 47A(1)(d)).

nodes.label: FACET — s 47A(2) notification limitation on deeming
nodes.body: Where the deemed dividend is (or would be) included under s 44 AND the taxpayer's return was not prepared on that basis AND the taxpayer did not notify the Commissioner in writing within 12 months after year-end (s 47A(2)(b)), the deemed dividend has effect for all purposes of the Act EXCEPT s 365 and Division 770 of ITAA 1997. This limits foreign tax credit and loss carry-back consequences.

nodes.label: FACET — Partnership/trust later-profit reduction (s 47A(18))
nodes.body: Where to look: s 47A(18) extends the s 47A(16)-(17) later-profit reduction to amounts included under s 44 through partnerships and trusts, preventing double counting when the distribution benefit flows through interposed entities.

nodes.label: FACET — Later amendment where s 47A(2) applicable (s 47A(18B))
nodes.body: Where to look: s 47A(18A) allows assessment on the assumption s 47A(2) will not apply. s 47A(18B) — if the Commissioner later becomes aware that s 47A(2) WAS applicable, the assessment may be amended at any time despite s 170.
